summary: Parse each exact identifier in a multi-value In-Reply-To header so the existing deterministic hash-only index does not split related email messages.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
Existing requirement to link only exact locally hashed email identifiers without semantic inference
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued email adaptability and accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: Only exact RFC-style header identifiers are linked; no subject, sender or semantic thread inference is performed.
MSG and mailbox synchronization remain unsupported.
Validation uses synthetic local EML files only and makes no model, mailbox or external provider request.
